summary: This standards-track RFC describes how to signal MAC address withdrawal over a static pseudowire, using the pseudowire associated channel. This is needed in VPLS and H-VPLS deployments where pseudowires are statically provisioned, so that stale MAC entries can be cleared when the topology changes.

eli5.summary: If a person moves house, the post office needs to forget their old address. This is a message that tells everyone to erase the old entry.
